name: user-config-store
body: User-config store: the per-user settings file store — locates the config file under the operating system's user config directory, reads it into a key-to-value map, writes a key (creating the file and its parent directory), unsets a key, lists the keys, and normalises the `default-template-library` value to an absolute path on set (`~` to the user's home directory, a relative path against the current working directory). Local filesystem only, no network. It is the storage half of domain.service.load-user-config and backs both the `kalide config` command and `kalide init`'s default-library resolution. Its intended home is a new internal package (a config store); the code is built by the plan.
